title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to plan and run paid and organic campaigns that generate quality leads.

Responsibilities:
- Set up, run and optimise Google Ads (Search, Performance Max) and Meta Ads campaigns
- Track leads, cost per lead and conversion rate; share weekly performance reports
- Coordinate with the design team on ad creatives and landing pages
- Manage Google Business Profile listings and respond to reviews
- Run A/B tests on ad copy, audiences and landing pages

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
- Working knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager (conversion tracking)
- Comfortable with Excel / Google Sheets for reporting
- Good written communication in English and Hindi

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
We are hiring a Full Stack Web Developer to build and maintain our customer-facing websites and internal tools.

Responsibilities:
- Build responsive web pages and features using React / Next.js
- Develop REST APIs in Node.js (Express) or PHP (Laravel)
- Integrate third-party services: payment gateways, CRMs, WhatsApp Business API
- Improve site speed, Core Web Vitals and technical SEO
- Write clean, reviewed code and deploy using Git-based workflows

Requirements:
- 2-5 years of professional web development experience
- Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- Experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL and schema design
- Familiarity with cloud hosting (AWS / DigitalOcean), Linux and Nginx
- Understanding of web security basics (auth, input validation, OWASP Top 10)
